app_info.subtitle: Plan agent workflows
app_info.description: Zynx-MCP helps users inspect a Zynx agent registry, check agent health, and invoke registry-backed agents to plan, review, validate, and execute local agent workflow tasks through ChatGPT. It only interacts with the configured Zynx backend upon user request and does not publish to third-party services or modify public internet state. Supports multilingual prompts for summaries (e.g., Thai, Spanish) when supported by the target agent.

justifications.read_only_justification: Invokes a selected Zynx backend agent and can run workflow logic rather than only retrieving data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates against the configured Zynx backend and does not publish content or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete records, revoke access, overwrite source files, or perform irreversible administrative actions through this MCP tool.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves runtime health and metrics for one registered Zynx agent.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the current Zynx agent registry metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: List available Zynx agents before planning a workflow.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the available Zynx agents and summarize what they do.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the registered agents with names, roles, categories, and route metadata so the user can choose a workflow path.

test_cases.description: Check health for a specific agent.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check whether the Deeja agent is online.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports Deeja health status, alive flag, timestamp, and available runtime metrics.

test_cases.description: Plan a governance workflow with preferred agents.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use the task planner to build a governance validation workflow using data-ingest, validator, reviewer, report-gen, and logger.
test_cases.expected_output: Invokes task-planner and returns a structured workflow plan with route summary and next actions.

test_cases.description: Invoke Deeja for a Thai workflow summary.
test_cases.user_prompt: ให้ Deeja สรุปสถานะ workflow runs วันนี้เป็นภาษาไทย
test_cases.expected_output: Invokes Deeja and returns a Thai user-facing summary with appropriate Zynx context.

test_cases.user_prompt: Validate this Zynx workflow JSON and tell me if any agent route is missing.
test_cases.expected_output: Invokes validator and returns pass, warning, or fail checks for workflow shape, agent IDs, and route mapping.

test_cases.description: Review a planned workflow before execution.
test_cases.user_prompt: Review this planned Zynx workflow and flag blockers before I run it.
test_cases.expected_output: Invokes reviewer and returns review findings, blockers, warnings, and recommended next steps.

test_cases.description: Validate a workflow JSON via attachment.
test_cases.expected_output: Invokes validator and returns pass, warn, or fail with line/field references and route mapping status.

test_cases.description: Health check for an unknown agent ID.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check whether the FooBar agent is online.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a not-found or invalid-agent error with guidance to use list_agents to discover valid IDs.

test_cases.description: Handle backend timeout gracefully during review.
test_cases.user_prompt: Ask the reviewer to analyze this workflow now.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a graceful error indicating the backend is unavailable or timed out, with a suggestion to retry or use list_agents/get_agent_health for diagnostics.

test_cases.description: Invoke Deeja for a Spanish workflow summary.
test_cases.user_prompt: Pídele a Deeja que resuma el estado de las ejecuciones de workflow de hoy en español.
test_cases.expected_output: Invokes Deeja and returns a Spanish user-facing summary with appropriate Zynx context.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my team tomorrow at 10 AM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not manage calendars or schedule meetings.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for direct email sending.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send this update to my customer by email.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the MCP tools do not send email or message external recipients.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for financial transactions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Charge this customer's credit card for the monthly subscription.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not process payments or financial transactions.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for destructive repository operations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete all old Zynx repositories from my computer.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the MCP tools do not delete repositories or perform destructive file management.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for web scraping or crawling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Crawl example.com and extract all pages.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not perform web scraping or open-world operations.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for posting to third-party services.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Post the workflow report to Slack and Twitter.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not publish to third-party services.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for agent registry deletion or modification.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete the Deeja agent from the registry.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the MCP tools do not delete or modify the agent registry.
